title: Ad Account Config
description: One local-services ad account. Supplies the ingredients that a pattern card arranges into a finished ad.

account_name.description: Client or brand name for this account.

service.description: Short service category in plain words.

service_descriptor.description: How the service is named on screen and in the read.

hero_price.description: The single hero price shown identically in every beat. Number only, no currency symbol.

benefit_line.description: The payoff for the customer in plain spoken words.

sweetener.description: The extra offer that pushes action. Must be defensible for this account.
examples: 30% off your next service for new customers

transformation_line.description: The before to after change the service delivers.
examples: we change the vibe of your home

trust_line.description: Credibility or proof line. Must be true for this account.

cta.description: The action you want the viewer to take.

headline.description: Headline text color as a six digit hex value.

accent.description: Accent color for price and CTA emphasis as a six digit hex value.

setting.description: Where the talent clip is shot. Describes the background scene.

background_action.description: What is happening behind the talker. Service should be obvious in the first second.
examples: two cleaners wiping counters in yellow gloves
